derivation: amendment A7: a rel=canonical link that also carries hreflang is still the page's canonical; A's canonical is B (non-self), so one `hreflang_canonical_not_self`.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: canonical-with-hreflang
